input.quote: At the request of Harpoon, AbbVie shall permit an independent public accounting firm of nationally recognized standing designated by Harpoon and reasonably acceptable to AbbVie, [***], to audit the books and records maintained pursuant to this Section 6.11
input.rationale: Section 6.11 is the audit right exercisable against us. Most material terms sit at or above the playbook fallback: frequency is capped at once in any stated period (with a look-back restriction), the audit is performed by an independent nationally recognized accounting firm reasonably acceptable to AbbVie, disclosure to Harpoon is limited to correctness and discrepancies, the auditor is bound by confidentiality (Section 6.13), the audit is limited to books and records (no access to AbbVie systems), and Harpoon bears the cost unless a variance threshold is exceeded. However, the audit is triggered simply "at the request of Harpoon" with no advance notice period and no business-hours limitation, so an audit could in effect be unannounced — this fails the fallback (15 days' notice) on a material term. Our redline inserts 30 days' prior written notice and a normal-business-hours limitation with a minimal edit; 15 days would be an acceptable fallback. The redacted variance threshold and the Audit Expert cost-allocation mechanic in Section 6.12 cannot be verified from the redacted text and are noted rather than flagged; our reciprocal inspection right at Section 3.8.6 benefits us and is not flagged.

proposal.summary: Add 30 days' prior written notice and business-hours limitation to Harpoon's audit right in Section 6.11
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6.11 caps audit frequency and puts cost on Harpoon, but permits an audit on request with no advance notice; we added thirty (30) days' prior written notice and a normal-business-hours limitation so audits do not disrupt operations. We can accept fifteen (15) days' notice if Harpoon prefers.

ops.oldText: At the request of Harpoon, AbbVie shall permit an independent public accounting firm
ops.newText: At the request of Harpoon, upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice to AbbVie and during AbbVie's normal business hours, AbbVie shall permit an independent public accounting firm
